import type { EngineInterface } from 'claude-code'

// The engine's reach, bound in register.tsx: the engine follows `$` only into functions of the hooks module's own
// file, so the bridge, watcher and pane modules get this port instead.
export type Host = {
  root: string
  exists(path: string): Promise<boolean>
  run: EngineInterface['process']['run']
  fetch: EngineInterface['http']['fetch']
  sleep(ms: number): Promise<void>
  log: EngineInterface['ui']['log']
  redraw(): void
  open: EngineInterface['ui']['open']
  close: EngineInterface['ui']['close']
  blit: EngineInterface['ui']['blit']
  fill: EngineInterface['prompt']['fill']
}

import type { BridgeState, Frame } from './bridge-protocol'

export const PANE = 'browser'
export const IMAGE_KEY = 'view'
export const START_URL = 'terminal-browser://start'

export type Grid = { cols: number; rows: number }

export const state = {
  port: null as number | null,
  token: null as string | null,
  open: false,
  pendingUrl: null as string | null,
  // The address last asked for, which the pane names until the first frame lands.
  requestedUrl: null as string | null,
  region: null as Grid | null,
  last: null as BridgeState | null,
  frame: null as Frame | null,
  mounted: null as Grid | null,
  watcher: 0,
  // a hack to programatically trigger agent input focus
  viewGeneration: 0,
  // A session drawn only off the terminal (the desktop app) gets no /browser and no pane.
  isOffTerminal: false,
}

export const bridgeUrl = (path: string) => `http://127.0.0.1:${state.port}${path}`
export const authHeaders = () => ({ authorization: `Bearer ${state.token}` })
export const viewKey = () => `view${state.viewGeneration}`

// we cannot use libraries inside the claude code sandbox, hence this gross code


export type Frame = {
  shm: string
  format: 'rgba' | 'rgb'
  width: number
  height: number
  generation: number
  cols: number
  rows: number
}

export type BridgeState = {
  version: number
  frame: Frame | null
  title: string
  url: string | null
  alive: boolean
  error: string | null
  inbox: number
}

export type LaunchReport =
  | { port: number; token: string }
  | { error: string; code: 'tty' | 'start' }

export type SizeMessage = { type: 'size'; cols: number; rows: number }
export type InputMessage = { type: 'input'; events: unknown[] }

const isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => typeof value === 'object' && value !== null

export const isFrame = (value: unknown): value is Frame =>
  isRecord(value)
  && typeof value.shm === 'string'
  && (value.format === 'rgba' || value.format === 'rgb')
  && Number.isInteger(value.width)
  && Number.isInteger(value.height)
  && Number.isInteger(value.generation)
  && Number.isInteger(value.cols)
  && Number.isInteger(value.rows)

export const isBridgeState = (value: unknown): value is BridgeState =>
  isRecord(value)
  && Number.isInteger(value.version)
  && typeof value.alive === 'boolean'
  && 'frame' in value
  && (value.frame === null || isFrame(value.frame))

export const isLaunchReport = (value: unknown): value is LaunchReport =>
  isRecord(value) && (typeof value.port === 'number' || typeof value.error === 'string')

export const isSizeMessage = (data: unknown): data is SizeMessage =>
  isRecord(data) && data.type === 'size' && Number.isInteger(data.cols) && Number.isInteger(data.rows)

export const isInputMessage = (data: unknown): data is InputMessage =>
  isRecord(data) && data.type === 'input' && Array.isArray(data.events)

export type AgentText = { text: string; screenshot: string | null }

const isAgentText = (value: unknown): value is AgentText =>
  isRecord(value) && typeof value.text === 'string' && (value.screenshot === null || typeof value.screenshot === 'string')

export const takenItems = (value: unknown): AgentText[] =>
  isRecord(value) && Array.isArray(value.items) ? value.items.filter(isAgentText) : []

// Every word the browser shows the person, in English and Turkish. Read through `pick` at draw time, after
// session.start has set the language.
import { pick } from './lang'

const EN = {
  command: 'Opens a browser on the right',
  closed: 'Browser closed',
  alreadyClosed: 'The browser is already closed',
  opened: 'Browser opened',
  startPage: 'Start page',
  paneTitle: 'Browser',
  eyebrow: '● BROWSER',
  loading: 'Loading the page…',
  died: 'The browser closed',
  retry: 'Try again with /browser · /browser close closes it',
  terminalOnly: 'terminal-browser runs only in the terminal',
  upgrade: 'This needs a newer terminal-browser: run terminal-browser upgrade',
  install: 'Install terminal-browser first',
  noStart: 'terminal-browser could not start',
}

const TR: typeof EN = {
  command: 'Sağda bir tarayıcı açar',
  closed: 'Tarayıcı kapatıldı',
  alreadyClosed: 'Tarayıcı zaten kapalı',
  opened: 'Tarayıcı açıldı',
  startPage: 'Başlangıç sayfası',
  paneTitle: 'Tarayıcı',
  eyebrow: '● TARAYICI',
  loading: 'Sayfa yükleniyor…',
  died: 'Tarayıcı kapandı',
  retry: '/browser ile yeniden dene · /browser close kapatır',
  terminalOnly: 'terminal-browser yalnızca terminalde çalışır',
  upgrade: 'Daha yeni bir terminal-browser gerekiyor: terminal-browser upgrade çalıştır',
  install: "Önce terminal-browser'ı kur",
  noStart: 'terminal-browser başlatılamadı',
}

export type Word = keyof typeof EN

export const word = (key: Word): string => pick({ en: EN, tr: TR })[key]

// The command's answer after opening: the start page by name in the sentence's own case, a real address whole.
export function openedText(url: string, isStart: boolean): string {
  const startPage = pick({ en: 'start page', tr: 'başlangıç sayfası' })

  return `${word('opened')}: ${isStart ? startPage : url}`
}
